A passkey can protect a Nostr account without turning recovery into magic.

Our 1 minute 5 second tutorial follows the Nostr WoT setup from Create with passkey through provider storage or an encrypted recovery file, then the 15-minute auto-lock default. The companion guide covers the same flow in seven languages.

The passkey is not a backup by itself.

We made this lesson for people creating a new Nostr identity who need to understand what their device stores, when a recovery file appears and what must remain available after setup.

An encrypted recovery file still needs an enrolled passkey. Provider confirmation also does not prove that recovery data has reached another device.
